title: Starter: Music
summary: A neutral music scaffold to copy: two plain generative phases (a pulse-wave one and a pad-and-drone one) with a generic hand-off each way, over a twelve-band pixel equaliser. No tune or story is written out; its first frame passes the lofi frame gate and its 48 s loop passes the music loop gate.
